messages:
Maya Singh: DeltaHealth security team pinged me — they need an ISO 27001 applicability statement for the POC asap. Also CAIQ/ SIG answers. POC starts Mon, pricing & Dedicated vs Hosted question in play. @Arjun can you confirm scope?
Arjun Patel: On it. Do they want the statement to explicitly cover Hosted API only? Or also Redwood Dedicated pools?
Maya Singh: Customer said: 'We'd prefer hosted for the POC but may move to Dedicated later. Need to know whether your ISO covers multitenant hosted API and Dedicated/reserved pools.'
Priya Kaur: Quick answer: our ISO 27001 scope covers Redwood's control plane and the hosted inference service we operate (multitenant hosted API) and the management layers in our cloud regions we control. Customer-managed Dedicated hardware or on-prem packages are NOT in scope by default — we classify those as customer-controlled.
Ben Lewis: They asked for formal docs: certificate PDF, Statement of Applicability (SoA), and a brief applicability statement they can pass to their risk team. Also they want CAIQ responses. Timeline: need initial pack by EOD Friday.
Sam Ortiz: Legal note — we can provide the cert/SoA and a narrowly tailored applicability statement. For CAIQ, we provide our completed CAIQ + mapping notes. If they request vendor attestation beyond that we may need an NDA addendum.
Priya Kaur: I'll assemble CAIQ answers and the SoA extract. Important callouts to include in applicability statement: encryption at rest/in transit, KMS usage, key ownership for hosted vs Dedicated, backup retention, incident response SLA, and shared responsibility for third-party cloud providers.
Arjun Patel: Suggested one-liner wording for the applicability statement to start with:
```
Suggested applicability statement: "Redwood Inference ISO 27001:2024 certification covers Redwood's cloud-hosted Control Plane and Hosted API services (including management, logging, and provisioning layers in our operated cloud regions). Dedicated customer regressions and customer-managed on-premises deployments are out of scope unless explicitly included via separate contract addendum."
```
Maya Singh: Perfect — I'll send that and the cert link. Where are the cert/SoA files?
docs-bot: Uploaded: https://internal.redwood.com/security/iso27001/2025-iso-cert.pdf and https://internal.redwood.com/security/iso27001/2025-soa.pdf :page_with_curl: 
Priya Kaur: FYI on CAIQ: I'll attach our completed CAIQ spreadsheet and a short mapping doc that highlights controls we don't perform (customer-owned). Also will call out A.11 physical security reliance on cloud provider and A.14 supplier management notes.
Ben Lewis: Customer also asked about encrypted backups in Dedicated — we need to call out KMS integration options and whether customer-managed keys are supported. @Priya can you note that we support BYOK for Dedicated/Private, and hosted uses Redwood-managed KMS?
Priya Kaur: Confirmed — BYOK is supported for Dedicated/Private deployments; hosted uses Redwood-managed keys by default. I'll include that explicitly.
Maya Singh: I'll draft an email to DeltaHealth with the certs + SoA snippet + CAIQ and ask for clarification on whether they need Dedicated included in scope for procurement. Will share the draft here before sending. :thumbsup: 
Sam Ortiz: If they request scope expansion, loop in legal for contract amendment and security for scope assessment.
Arjun Patel: For the POC, we should offer a short security addendum template (1 page) that states scope for hosted POC only — I can draft.
Maya Singh: Thanks everyone — target to share draft with customer by 5pm PST today. If anything blocks, ping here.
Priya Kaur: Uploading CAIQ and SoA excerpt now. I'll post links once done.
docs-bot: Uploaded: https://internal.redwood.com/security/caqi/2025-caIQ-redwood.xlsx :file_folder: 
Maya Singh: Received, thanks. I'll post the customer email thread after I send.
Ben Lewis: quick note on pricing: POC pricing won't change based on ISO scope, but Dedicated prep may incur setup fees. I'll include that in response.
Maya Singh: noted. Sending now. :rocket:
